card.title: 5th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card.text: Gets +1+1 when it moves into the frontline.
card.flavorText: The origin of the 5th Infantry Regiment of the US Army dates back to 1808 and it has participated in American conflicts since The War of 1812. During WWII the regiment was being trained as a light infantry unit capable of operating in harsh conditions, including both mountain and desert combat. However, a light infantry division was not needed at the time and the regiment was dispatched to Europe in 1945 as a regular infantry regiment. The 5th Infantry Regiment fought with the 79th Infantry Division in the south of Germany and captured the cities of Nuremberg, Fulda and Bayreuth. The regiment was the first US Army unit to cross the Danube River and the first to invade Austria where it performed occupation duty after the war.
